text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: OOOOOOOOOH!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Oh-ho!
When it comes to top speed, it's Calstone Light O after all!
What unbelievable speed-ッ!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Are you leaving? Are you really leaving!?
Even the mighty "Holy Sword" fails to cut through light—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Like I'd ever... miss my strike—!!!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: "Calstone-san, do you have one!? Someone waiting for your victory?"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Do you have one?!
Someone you want to devote yourself to from the bottom of your heart."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I have someone!!
Someone more precious to me than anything else.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: The person who believed in me more than anyone else. When I was a wanderer with nowhere to serve...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
There was someone who placed their hopes in me, who grew alongside me,
and guided me forward with unwavering strength.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"If you have no master you wish to support,
then I refuse to lose to someone like you!"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I am a knight! In order to elevate
the king I believe in higher than all others!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Blade of Radiance, Churold's Anthem of Triumph!
HAAAAAAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Ggggrrrk!? What is this...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Surpassed... light itself, you say...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The ultimate sprint showdown has concluded—!!
Taking the victory is Durandal!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She proved that there is nothing
her late-kick burst cannot cut through!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa...
My loyalty... my devotion to my King...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Faster than light, and... more brilliant.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: I am... I am the one who—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: "I am my King's First Knight!"
(Oooooooo!?)

Everyone cheered at her supremely
confident pose.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(I practiced this winning pose...
quite a lot, too...)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(Thank goodness...
I got to show it off alongside a satisfying victory.)

For some reason, Durandal had
a slightly relieved look on her face.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Durandal.
Farewell.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Wait, after a showdown like that...
you don't have any last words to say?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Things like "That was a magnificent strike," or
"This is merely the beginning."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
No, not really. It literally just ended,
so there's no way it's just the beginning.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
All that's left for me is to master maximum speed.
See ya!

...Before there was even time to savor the moment,
Calstone Light O was already gone.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
My King, I have returned in triumph.
I dedicate this victory... to you.
choice_data_list: Yeah, great work! Thank you so much!
Yeah, good work! Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: On the contrary, I am grateful beyond words.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
For giving me... a reason to run.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(Yes, it's not just about winning or losing.
Nor is it simply about fulfilling ambition...)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(Fulfilling my duty like this,
and being rewarded... What joy...)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(This bond is eternal... Even if
I can't say that for certain...)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(Something will remain. Something that will never fade
surely...)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
My King.
Next is the Mile Championship, as we declared.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
On the line is—
a second consecutive sprint GⅠ victory,
and winning the same GⅠ two years in a row.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I shall prove it through those achievements.
That you—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Surpassing even Her Royal Highness Fine Motion,
he was the foremost king of the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
The next battle is not a tournament between knights.
Indeed—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: This is the ultimate decisive battle, with our pride and prestige on the line.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Congratulations on winning the Sprinters Stakes,
Durandal. And..."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I'll be waiting for you, at the Mile Championship.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Spending the grand finale of three wonderful years
together with you♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yeah, let's give it everything I've learned in this country!

"This time, I am not here to merely learn from a superior.
As a proud pioneer of the sprint division,
I challenge the Princess to a decisive battle."

The Mile CS looks like it will be the greatest ritual
for us, and for Fine Motion as well.
